Experiments Here, we illustrate our results on a synthetic, streaming k-PCA problem using the SGD algorithm defined in Eq. (5). We take k=10 and d=50. The stream Hn ∈Rd is normally-distributed with a covariance matrix H with random eigenvectors, and eigenvalues decaying as 1/iα +β, for i ≤ k, and 1/(i−1)α , for i > k and α, β ≥ 0.
